name: Air-gun BB
definition: round steel or plated BB shot made for BB guns and some air rifles.
notes: Airgun Depot lists Airgun BBs apart from Airgun Pellets; Barra Airguns has an Airgun BBs collection.

name: Birdshot shotshell
definition: shotgun shell loaded with many small pellets for birds, clays and small game.
notes: True Shot Ammo has a Birdshot Shotgun Ammo collection.

name: Buckshot shotshell
definition: shotgun shell loaded with a few large pellets for defence and big game.
notes: Able Ammo has a 12 Gauge Buckshot category.

name: Slug shotshell
definition: shotgun shell loaded with one heavy projectile.
notes: Able Ammo has a 12 Gauge Slugs category.
